items.title: Withdraw from cleaning subscription contract (Widerruf)
items.quote: Innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Vertragsschluss können Sie sich ohne Begründung wieder von diesem Vertrag lösen, indem Sie ihn widerrufen.
items.computation: Contract concluded at the sales stand on 21.11.2026 (Saturday), confirmed directly to the customer the same day, so the 14-day withdrawal period runs 'nach Vertragsschluss' (from contract conclusion), not from a later delivery. Under § 187(1) BGB the day of the triggering event (21.11.2026) is not counted; the period starts 22.11.2026. Under § 188(2) BGB a period of days ends with the day that, by its designation, corresponds to the triggering day after the stated number of days: 21.11.2026 + 14 days = 05.12.2026. That date is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day. The next business day is Monday 07.12.2026 (no Baden-Württemberg public holiday on 05.12. or 06.12. or 07.12.2026). It suffices that the withdrawal is sent ('absenden') by that date.
